title: Throwing away everything below revision 3
note: Compaction is not a write. The revision in this header is the store's clock as it already was; nothing was appended to make room.

title: Reading a revision that has been compacted away
note: An empty answer would be a lie: there was a value at revision 2, and the store no longer knows it. Code 11 is how a paging reader learns it has fallen behind and must start again from the current revision.

response_fields.value: "etcdserver: mvcc: required revision has been compacted"
